intro: Warcaller Gorlach is an orc herald roaming the dusty streets of Orgrimmar, calling champions of the Horde to distant battlefronts. True to his title, he rallies travelers and seasoned warriors to answer commands in perilous outposts across Kalimdor and beyond.

p: Patrolling the thoroughfares of Orgrimmar, Warcaller Gorlach serves as a primary herald for the Horde's expansion and strategic defenses. Rather than staying confined to a garrison desk, he marches among the citizenry, issuing orders directly to volunteers ready to test their mettle. Whether dispatching hunters into the contested canopy of Ashenvale, directing scouts toward the wilderness of Camp Mojache in Feralas, or issuing desperate calls to arms for distant campaigns like the Plaguelands, Gorlach ensures that no warrior lingering in the capital remains idle while the Horde faces threats abroad.
